reason: Hypothesis A is more physically sound for high-temperature bond coats, proposing a well-established reactive-element effect mechanism (Y segregation, oxide scale adherence) without over-specifying the alloy or relying on questionable evidence. Hypothesis B incorrectly cites evidence about Y2O3 in FeCoNi and Mn oxidation in CrMnFeCoNi to support a mechanism that is not directly applicable, and it introduces an unsubstantiated Mn-depletion mitigation claim.
